requirements.title: REC specifies the direct-access record number
requirements.definition: The REC= specifier specifies the number of the record that is to be read or written.

pending.rec-specifies-record-number: Create a direct-access file with known RECL and two distinct records; use REC=2 to read the second record into a sentinel target and assert the second value, not file representation.

requirements.title: Other transfers are sequential or stream according to the connection
requirements.definition: Any other data transfer statement is sequential access or stream access depending on whether the file connection is sequential or stream.

pending.non-rec-transfer-sequential-if-sequentia: Open a sequential file, omit REC= and POS=, write/read two distinct records in order; assert sequence effect, not byte representation.
pending.non-rec-transfer-stream-if-stream-connec: Open a stream file, omit REC=, use stream positioning/inquiry to observe stream behavior; POS-specific effects remain owned by 12.6.2.12.

Defines non-REC transfer classification by connection.

review_rationale: Source registration for 12.6.2.2-12.6.2.16, the individual io-control-spec specifiers (batch160). Every unit hash-verified by independent reviewers across two rounds. Each temporary mode specifier is split into its value restriction, its one-statement effect with restoration of the connection mode (observed by INQUIRE after the statement), and the omitted-means-unchanged rule. Round 1 found a pending plan expecting exact output from I2 on a positive value without fixing the sign mode; it now uses SS, and a sweep found no other plus-, leading-zero- or rounding-dependent exact output. R1215 and C1232 were pre-accounted. Source accounting only.
